jawaban: Would you like to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
pembahasan: "Would you like to come...?" adalah ungkapan ajakan (invitation). "I'd love to" adalah jawaban menerima ajakan, "Hi, Sinta!" adalah sapaan, dan "See you on Saturday!" adalah ucapan perpisahan.
pilihan: Would you like to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
soal:
Read the dialog.
Rina: "Hi, Sinta! Would you like to come to my birthday party on Saturday?"
Sinta: "I'd love to. Thank you!"

Which sentence is an invitation?

jawaban: How about joining our English club this afternoon?
pembahasan: "How about joining...?" adalah ungkapan ajakan. "That sounds great. I'll join you" adalah jawaban menerima ajakan, sedangkan dua pilihan lain hanya sapaan.
pilihan: That sounds great. I'll join you.
How about joining our English club this afternoon?
soal:
Read the dialog.
Budi: "Hello, Andi. How about joining our English club this afternoon?"
Andi: "That sounds great. I'll join you."

Which sentence is an invitation?

jawaban: Would you like to have lunch with me at the canteen?
pembahasan: "Would you like to have lunch with me...?" mengajak seseorang melakukan sesuatu, jadi itu ungkapan ajakan. "Sure, I'd like to" adalah jawaban menerima ajakan.
pilihan: The canteen is near the library.
Would you like to have lunch with me at the canteen?
soal:
Read the dialog.
Dina: "Would you like to have lunch with me at the canteen?"
Maya: "Sure, I'd like to."

Which sentence is an invitation?

jawaban: Let's play football after school. Do you want to join us?
pembahasan: "Let's play football... Do you want to join us?" adalah ajakan. "Yes, I do" adalah jawaban menerima, sedangkan "I like football" hanya menyatakan kesukaan.
pilihan: Let's play football after school. Do you want to join us?
soal:
Read the dialog.
Rudi: "Let's play football after school. Do you want to join us?"
Tono: "Yes, I do. See you at the field."

Which sentence is an invitation?

jawaban: Would you like to study together at my house tomorrow?
pembahasan: "Would you like to study together...?" adalah ungkapan ajakan. "Yes, please" dan "What time?" adalah respon dari orang yang diajak.
pilihan: Would you like to study together at my house tomorrow?
soal:
Read the dialog.
Sari: "Hi, Lina. Would you like to study together at my house tomorrow?"
Lina: "Yes, please. What time?"

Which sentence is an invitation?

jawaban: Would you like to watch a movie with me tonight?
pembahasan: "Would you like to watch a movie with me tonight?" adalah ajakan. Jawaban Dewi menolak ajakan itu dengan alasan harus belajar, jadi itu bukan ajakan.
pilihan: Would you like to watch a movie with me tonight?
I'd love to, but I have to study for the test.
soal:
Read the dialog.
Agus: "Would you like to watch a movie with me tonight?"
Dewi: "I'd love to, but I have to study for the test."

Which sentence is an invitation?

pembahasan: Untuk menerima ajakan dipakai ungkapan seperti "That sounds great. I'd love to come." Dua pilihan pertama adalah penolakan, sedangkan "I don't like dinner" tidak sopan dan bukan respon menerima ajakan.
pilihan: I'm sorry, I can't. I have to help my mother.
That sounds great. I'd love to come.
No, thank you. I'm busy tonight.
soal:
Read the dialog.
Rina: "Would you like to come to my house for dinner tonight?"
Sinta: "..."

What is the correct response to accept the invitation?

jawaban: Sure, that would be fun. Let's go!
pembahasan: "Sure, that would be fun. Let's go!" menerima ajakan dengan sopan dan antusias. Pilihan pertama menolak, sedangkan dua pilihan terakhir kasar dan bukan respon menerima.
pilihan: I'm sorry, I can't. I have an English course.
Sure, that would be fun. Let's go!
soal:
Read the dialog.
Budi: "How about playing badminton with me this afternoon?"

What is the correct response to accept the invitation?

pembahasan: Menolak ajakan dengan sopan memakai "I'm sorry, I can't" disertai alasan. Pilihan pertama menerima, pilihan ketiga kasar, pilihan keempat bukan respon terhadap ajakan.
pilihan: I'm sorry, I can't. I have to visit my grandmother on Sunday.
Yes, I'd love to. See you there!
soal:
Read the dialog.
Dina: "Would you like to join our picnic on Sunday?"
Maya: "..."

What is the correct response to refuse the invitation politely?

jawaban: I'm afraid I can't. I have football practice after school.
pembahasan: "I'm afraid I can't" + alasan adalah penolakan yang sopan. Pilihan pertama menerima ajakan, "Go away!" kasar, dan pilihan terakhir hanya komentar tentang perpustakaan.
pilihan: I'm afraid I can't. I have football practice after school.
soal:
Read the dialog.
Rudi: "Let's go to the library after school. Do you want to come with me?"
Tono: "..."

What is the correct response to refuse the invitation politely?

pembahasan: Permintaan izin "May I borrow...?" dijawab dengan memberi izin, misalnya "Of course. Here it is." "You're welcome" dipakai untuk membalas ucapan terima kasih, bukan permintaan izin.
soal:
Read the dialog.
Rina: "May I borrow your dictionary, please?"
Sinta: "..."

What is the correct response to the request?

pembahasan: Untuk permintaan izin "Can I use your pen?", jawaban yang memberi izin adalah "Yes, sure. Here you are." "Thank you very much" adalah ucapan terima kasih, bukan jawaban atas permintaan izin.
soal:
Read the dialog.
Budi: "Can I use your pen, please?"
Andi: "..."

What is the correct response to the request?

pembahasan: "May I go to the toilet?" adalah cara sopan meminta izin. "Must" menyatakan kewajiban, "should" menyatakan saran, dan "will" tidak cocok untuk meminta izin dalam kalimat ini.
soal:
Complete the dialog.
Dina: "___ I go to the toilet, Miss?"
Teacher: "Yes, you may."

Which expression is correct to ask for permission?

pembahasan: "Can I open the window, please?" adalah cara meminta izin yang benar. "Must" dan "have to" menyatakan kewajiban, "should" menyatakan saran, jadi ketiganya tidak cocok.
soal:
Complete the dialog.
Rudi: "___ I open the window, please? It's very hot here."
Sari: "Yes, of course."

Which expression is correct to ask for permission?

jawaban: Yes, you may, but please tell your parents first.
pembahasan: Jawaban yang memberi izin adalah "Yes, you may..." Dua pilihan pertama menolak izin, sedangkan "I don't know" bukan jawaban atas permintaan izin.
pilihan: No, you can't. You must stay here.
Yes, you may, but please tell your parents first.
I'm sorry, you can't go home now.
soal:
Read the dialog.
Maya: "Can I go home early today, Sir? I feel sick."

What is the correct response to give permission?

jawaban: I'm sorry, you can't. The computers are for the teachers only.
pembahasan: Menolak izin dengan sopan memakai "I'm sorry, you can't" disertai alasan. Dua pilihan pertama memberi izin, sedangkan "Thank you" bukan jawaban atas permintaan izin.
pilihan: Yes, you may. Please be quiet.
Of course. Here is the password.
I'm sorry, you can't. The computers are for the teachers only.
soal:
Read the dialog.
Andi: "May I use the computer in the library, Miss?"
Librarian: "..."

What is the correct response to refuse permission?

pembahasan: "May I ask a question?" adalah ungkapan meminta izin yang sopan. "Must" menyatakan kewajiban dan "should" menyatakan saran, sedangkan "Do I ask a question?" bukan bentuk meminta izin.
soal:
Complete the dialog.
Sari: "Excuse me, Sir. ___ I ask a question?"
Teacher: "Yes, please."

Which expression is correct to ask for permission?

pembahasan: "Can I sit here, please?" adalah cara meminta izin yang benar dan umum. "Should" menyatakan saran dan "must" menyatakan kewajiban, jadi tidak cocok di sini.
soal:
Complete the dialog.
Dewi: "___ I sit here, please?"
Agus: "Yes, please. Sit down."

Which expression is correct to ask for permission?

jawaban: No, not at all. Please do.
pembahasan: "Do you mind if I open the window?" adalah permintaan izin yang sopan. Jawaban yang memberi izin adalah "No, not at all. Please do." ("No" di sini artinya "tidak keberatan"). "Yes, I mind" justru menolak, sedangkan dua pilihan lain bukan jawaban atas permintaan izin.
pilihan: Yes, I mind. Don't open it.
No, not at all. Please do.
soal:
Read the dialog.
Rina: "Do you mind if I open the window? It's very hot here."
Sinta: "..."

What is the correct response to give permission?

jawaban: Not at all. Here you are.
pembahasan: "Would you mind if I borrowed your book?" dijawab dengan memberi izin: "Not at all. Here you are." "Yes, I mind" menolak izin, sedangkan "I don't know" dan "I like books" bukan jawaban atas permintaan izin.
pilihan: Yes, I mind. I need it now.
Not at all. Here you are.
soal:
Read the dialog.
Budi: "Would you mind if I borrowed your book for a moment?"
Andi: "..."

What is the correct response to give permission?

jawaban: What do you think about the new English book?
pembahasan: Untuk meminta pendapat dipakai pertanyaan "What do you think about...?" "What do you do?" menanyakan pekerjaan, "Where do you live?" menanyakan tempat tinggal, dan "How old are you?" menanyakan umur.
pilihan: What do you think about the new English book?
soal:
Read the conversation.
Rina: "..."
Sinta: "I think it is very interesting and easy to understand."

Which question does Rina ask to ask for an opinion?

jawaban: How do you feel about the school festival?
pembahasan: "How do you feel about...?" adalah pertanyaan untuk meminta pendapat. "How are you?" menanyakan kabar, "Where is the festival?" menanyakan tempat, dan "When is the festival?" menanyakan waktu.
pilihan: How do you feel about the school festival?
soal:
Read the conversation.
Budi: "..."
Andi: "I think it is very fun. I like the music and the food."

Which question does Budi ask to ask for an opinion?

pembahasan: Tabel menunjukkan: English 18 students, Mathematics 12, Science 9, Art 6. Jumlah terbanyak adalah English (18), jadi pendapat yang benar adalah "Most students like English best." Art justru paling sedikit (6).
soal:
Look at the table about students' favourite school subjects.
English: 18 students. Mathematics: 12 students. Science: 9 students. Art: 6 students.

jawaban: In my opinion, the park is beautiful and comfortable.
pembahasan: Gambar menunjukkan taman yang bersih dengan banyak bunga, pohon hijau, dan anak-anak yang bermain. Ungkapan pendapat yang tepat adalah "In my opinion, the park is beautiful and comfortable." Dua pilihan lain hanya menyatakan fakta tentang taman, bukan pendapat, dan "I go to the park every day" bukan ungkapan pendapat.
pilihan: In my opinion, the park is beautiful and comfortable.
There are three trees in the park.
I go to the park every day.
soal:

Rudi gives his opinion about the park. Which expression is correct?

jawaban: I think the new library is very comfortable for studying.
pembahasan: Gambar menunjukkan perpustakaan baru yang terang, rak-rak penuh buku, dan siswa yang membaca di meja. Ungkapan pendapat yang tepat adalah "I think the new library is very comfortable for studying." Dua pilihan lain hanya menyatakan fakta, dan "I go to the library every day" bukan ungkapan pendapat.

I think the new library is very comfortable for studying.
I go to the library every day.
soal:

Sinta gives her opinion about the library. Which expression is correct?

pembahasan: "I think the film is very interesting" adalah ungkapan memberi pendapat. "The film starts at 7 p.m." adalah fakta, "I watched the film yesterday" adalah pengalaman, dan "The film is in the cinema" adalah fakta tempat.
pilihan: The film is in the cinema.
I think the film is very interesting.

pilihan: The food is on the table.
In my opinion, the traditional food is very delicious.

Rudi: "What is your opinion about the traditional food here?"

Which expression is correct to give an opinion?

pembahasan: Gambar menunjukkan rambu "No Smoking" di koridor rumah sakit, yaitu larangan merokok. Larangan yang sesuai adalah "Don't smoke in the hospital." "Don't eat in the hospital" tidak ada dalam gambar, "You must smoke here" justru kebalikan dari larangan, dan "Don't run" tidak berhubungan dengan rambu itu.
pilihan: You must smoke in the hospital.
soal:

pembahasan: Gambar menunjukkan rambu "No Littering" di taman, yaitu larangan membuang sampah sembarangan. Larangan yang sesuai adalah "Don't throw rubbish in the park." Pilihan lain tidak berhubungan dengan rambu itu.
pilihan: Don't throw rubbish in the park.
Don't play football in the park.
soal:

"Don't fish here" dan "Don't play on the beach" tidak sesuai dengan rambu, dan "You must swim here" justru kebalikan dari larangan.
pilihan: Don't swim here. The waves are dangerous.

pilihan: Don't drive your car to school.
Don't walk through the school gate.
Don't park your car in front of the school gate.
Don't stop your car in the parking area.
soal:
Look at the picture. It shows a "No Parking" sign in front of the school gate. A car is parked near the gate.

Which prohibition is suitable for the picture?

jawaban: Students must wear a uniform to school every day.
pembahasan: Kalimat kewajiban memakai "must" atau "have to". Hanya kalimat "Students must wear a uniform to school every day" yang memakai "must". "Can" menyatakan kemampuan, "should" menyatakan saran, dan "may" menyatakan izin.
pilihan: Students must wear a uniform to school every day.
Students can play football after school.
Students may go home after school.
soal: Which sentence states an obligation using "must" or "have to"?

jawaban: You have to finish your homework before Friday.
pembahasan: Kalimat kewajiban memakai "must" atau "have to". Hanya kalimat "You have to finish your homework before Friday" yang memakai "have to". Pilihan lain memakai "can", "should", dan "may", yang bukan kewajiban.
pilihan: You can watch TV after dinner.
You should eat vegetables every day.
You have to finish your homework before Friday.
soal: Which sentence states an obligation using "must" or "have to"?

pembahasan: Kalimat ini menyatakan kewajiban, jadi kata yang tepat adalah "must": "Students must wear a uniform to school." "May" menyatakan izin, "can" menyatakan kemampuan, dan "could" menyatakan kemungkinan, jadi ketiganya tidak tepat.
soal:
Complete the sentence.
Students ___ wear a uniform to school.

Which word states an obligation?

pembahasan: Kalimat ini menyatakan kewajiban, jadi kata yang tepat adalah "have to": "I have to go to the dentist tomorrow. I have an appointment." "May", "can", dan "could" tidak menyatakan kewajiban.
soal:
Complete the sentence.
I ___ go to the dentist tomorrow. I have an appointment.

Which word states an obligation?

pembahasan: Gambar menunjukkan seorang anak mencuci tangan dengan sabun di wastafel. Instruksi memakai kata kerja bentuk dasar (imperative): "First, wash your hands with soap and water." "Washing", "washed", dan "to wash" bukan bentuk perintah yang benar di sini.
soal:

soal:

"___ the light before you leave the room."

soal:
Look at the picture. It shows a "Please Queue in Line" sign in a room with a food counter. Some students are standing in a line to buy food.

Where is the instruction given?

pembahasan: "You should drink warm water" adalah ekspresi saran (suggestion). "You must drink warm water" adalah kewajiban, "Can you drink warm water?" adalah pertanyaan, dan "I drink warm water every day" adalah pernyataan kebiasaan.
pilihan: I drink warm water every day.
soal:
Read the conversation.

pilihan: Why don't you take a rest? You look tired.
I take a rest every day.

You should go to bed early tonight.

pilihan: You should practise English every day.
You should only play games after school.
You should take a nap in the afternoon.
soal:
Read the conversation.
Rina: "My English score is very low. I seldom practise English at home."
Sinta: "..."

soal:
Read the announcement.
"ANNOUNCEMENT

jawaban: Only students of grade 8 can join the competition.
pembahasan: Pengumuman itu berbunyi: lomba membaca puisi hanya untuk siswa kelas 8, diadakan di aula pada hari Jumat pukul 10 pagi. Pilihan pertama salah (lomba untuk kelas 8, bukan semua kelas), pilihan ketiga salah waktu (bukan pukul 8), dan pilihan keempat salah tempat (bukan perpustakaan).
pilihan: All students can join the competition.
The competition will be held at 8 a.m.
Only students of grade 8 can join the competition.
The competition will be held in the library.
soal:
Read the announcement.
"ANNOUNCEMENT
There will be a poetry reading competition for grade 8 students only. The competition will be held in the school hall on Friday at 10 a.m. Please register with your English teacher before Wednesday."

Which statement is correct according to the announcement?

pembahasan: Pernyataan itu adalah fakta: teks memang menyebutkan perpustakaan sekolah buka pukul 7 pagi. Fakta adalah informasi yang benar dan bisa dibuktikan, sedangkan opini adalah pendapat pribadi.
soal:
Read the text.
"Our school library is big and clean. It has five thousand books. It opens at 7 a.m. and closes at 3 p.m. Many students read books there every day."

Statement: "The school library opens at 7 a.m." is a fact.

pembahasan: Pernyataan itu adalah opini, bukan fakta: "the most beautiful place in the world" adalah pendapat pribadi yang tidak bisa dibuktikan. Fakta adalah informasi yang benar dan bisa dibuktikan, sedangkan opini adalah pendapat pribadi.
soal:
Read the text.
"Kuta Beach is in Bali. The sand is white and the water is blue. Many tourists visit the beach every year. The beach is the most beautiful place in the world."

Statement: "The beach is the most beautiful place in the world." is a fact.

pembahasan: Pernyataan itu adalah fakta: teks menyebutkan Milo berbulu putih dan bermata hijau. Fakta adalah informasi yang benar dan bisa dibuktikan.
soal:
Read the text.
"I have a cat. His name is Milo. He has white fur and green eyes. He likes to sleep on my bed. He is very cute."

Statement: "Milo has white fur and green eyes." is a fact.

pembahasan: Pernyataan itu adalah opini, bukan fakta: "the best player in the world" adalah pendapat pribadi yang tidak bisa dibuktikan. Fakta dalam teks adalah ia bermain untuk timnas dan mencetak 20 gol musim lalu.
soal:
Read the text.
"Ronaldo is a famous football player. He plays for the national team. He scored twenty goals last season. He is the best player in the world."

Statement: "He is the best player in the world." is a fact.

pembahasan: Pernyataan itu tidak sesuai dengan teks: Rani tinggal di desa kecil dekat sungai, bukan di kota besar, dan ia berjalan kaki ke sekolah setiap hari. Jadi pernyataan "Rani lives in a big city" adalah salah.
soal:
Read the text.
"Rani lives in a small village near a river. She walks to school every day. Her school is near her house. She likes her village very much."

Statement: Rani lives in a big city.

pembahasan: Pernyataan itu sesuai dengan teks: pasar itu buka setiap hari pukul 6 pagi dan menjual buah serta sayuran segar. Jadi pernyataan "The market opens at 6 a.m. every day" adalah benar.
soal:
Read the text.
"There is a traditional market near my house. It opens at 6 a.m. every day. It sells fresh fruit and vegetables. Many people buy food there in the morning."

Statement: The market opens at 6 a.m. every day.

pembahasan: Pernyataan itu sesuai dengan teks: Borobudur terletak di Magelang, Jawa Tengah, dan dibangun pada abad ke-9. Jadi pernyataan "Borobudur is in Magelang, Central Java" adalah benar.
soal:
Read the text.
"Borobudur is a famous temple in Indonesia. It is in Magelang, Central Java. It was built in the ninth century. Many tourists visit Borobudur every year."

Statement: Borobudur is in Magelang, Central Java.

pembahasan: Pernyataan itu tidak sesuai dengan teks: perpustakaan itu mempunyai lima ribu buku, bukan sepuluh ribu buku. Jadi pernyataan "The library has ten thousand books" adalah salah.
soal:
Read the text.
"Our school library is big and clean. It has five thousand books. It opens at 7 a.m. and closes at 3 p.m. Many students read books there every day."

Statement: The library has ten thousand books.

pembahasan: Pernyataan itu tidak sesuai dengan teks: Budi pergi ke sekolah dengan sepeda, bukan dengan bus. Jadi pernyataan "Budi goes to school by bus" adalah salah.
soal:
Read the text.
"Budi is a student at SMP Bina Putra. He goes to school by bicycle every day. His school is two kilometres from his house. He likes riding his bicycle in the morning."

Statement: Budi goes to school by bus.

pembahasan: Pernyataan itu sesuai dengan teks: Sari mempunyai dua kakak laki-laki dan satu adik perempuan, dan ia adalah anak ketiga. Jadi pernyataan "Sari has two older brothers" adalah benar.
soal:
Read the text.
"Sari is a student in grade 8. She has two older brothers and one younger sister. She is the third child in her family. She likes reading books and singing."

Statement: Sari has two older brothers.

pembahasan: "Would you like to come to my house this weekend?" adalah ungkapan ajakan (inviting someone). Ungkapan ini mengajak orang lain melakukan sesuatu, bukan meminta izin, meminta pendapat, atau memberi saran.
soal:
Match the expression with its meaning or function.
Expression: "Would you like to come to my house this weekend?"

pembahasan: "How about playing football after school?" adalah ungkapan ajakan (inviting someone). Ungkapan ini mengajak orang lain bermain sepak bola, bukan meminta izin atau memberi pendapat.
soal:
Match the expression with its meaning or function.
Expression: "How about playing football after school?"

pembahasan: "May I use your ruler, please?" adalah ungkapan meminta izin (asking for permission). Kata "May I" menunjukkan permintaan izin, bukan ajakan atau pendapat.
soal:
Match the expression with its meaning or function.
Expression: "May I use your ruler, please?"

pembahasan: "Can I go to the toilet, Miss?" adalah ungkapan meminta izin (asking for permission). Kata "Can I" menunjukkan permintaan izin kepada guru.
soal:
Match the expression with its meaning or function.
Expression: "Can I go to the toilet, Miss?"

pembahasan: "What is your opinion about online classes?" adalah ungkapan meminta pendapat (asking for an opinion). Kata "What is your opinion" menunjukkan permintaan pendapat, bukan ajakan atau saran.
soal:
Match the expression with its meaning or function.
Expression: "What is your opinion about online classes?"

pembahasan: "How do you feel about the new canteen?" adalah ungkapan meminta pendapat (asking for an opinion). Kata "How do you feel about" menanyakan pendapat seseorang tentang kantin baru.
soal:
Match the expression with its meaning or function.
Expression: "How do you feel about the new canteen?"

pembahasan: "You should study harder for the exam." adalah ungkapan memberi saran (giving a suggestion). Kata "should" di sini memberi saran, bukan menyatakan kewajiban yang keras seperti "must".
soal:
Match the expression with its meaning or function.
Expression: "You should study harder for the exam."

pembahasan: "You'd better take an umbrella. It's going to rain." adalah ungkapan memberi saran (giving a suggestion). "You'd better" dipakai untuk memberi saran yang baik, bukan untuk meminta izin atau mengajak.
soal:
Match the expression with its meaning or function.
Expression: "You'd better take an umbrella. It's going to rain."

pembahasan: "Students must wear a uniform every Monday." adalah ungkapan menyatakan kewajiban (stating an obligation). Kata "must" menunjukkan sesuatu yang wajib dilakukan, bukan sekadar saran.
soal:
Match the expression with its meaning or function.
Expression: "Students must wear a uniform every Monday."

pembahasan: "You have to submit your homework today." adalah ungkapan menyatakan kewajiban (stating an obligation). Kata "have to" menunjukkan sesuatu yang wajib dilakukan, bukan sekadar saran.
soal:
Match the expression with its meaning or function.
Expression: "You have to submit your homework today."

pembahasan: Kalimat ajakan yang benar adalah "Would you like to join us for lunch tomorrow?" Kata "join" (ikut/bergabung) cocok setelah "to". Kata "joining" tidak cocok karena setelah "to" dipakai kata kerja bentuk dasar.
soal:
Complete the sentence.
"Would you like to ___ us for lunch tomorrow?"

pembahasan: Kalimat ajakan yang benar adalah "How about playing football with us after school?" Setelah "How about" dipakai kata kerja + -ing, jadi jawabannya "playing".
soal:
Complete the sentence.
"How about ___ football with us after school?"

pembahasan: Kalimat kewajiban yang benar adalah "Students must wear a uniform on Monday." Kata "must" menyatakan kewajiban. Kata "may" menyatakan izin dan "can" menyatakan kemampuan, jadi keduanya tidak tepat.
soal:
Complete the sentence.
"Students ___ wear a uniform on Monday."

pembahasan: Kalimat kewajiban yang benar adalah "You have to submit your homework before Friday." Frasa "have to" menyatakan kewajiban. Kata "may" menyatakan izin dan "can" menyatakan kemampuan, jadi keduanya tidak tepat.
soal:
Complete the sentence.
"You ___ submit your homework before Friday."

pembahasan: Kalimat saran yang benar adalah "You should drink a lot of water when you are sick." Kata "should" dipakai untuk memberi saran. Kata "must" menyatakan kewajiban yang keras dan kurang cocok untuk saran ini.
soal:
Complete the sentence.
"You ___ drink a lot of water when you are sick."

pembahasan: Kalimat saran yang benar adalah "Why don't you take a rest? You look tired." Setelah "Why don't you" dipakai kata kerja bentuk dasar, yaitu "take". Frasa "take a rest" berarti beristirahat.
soal:
Complete the sentence.
"Why don't you ___ a rest? You look tired."

pembahasan: Kalimat ajakan yang benar adalah "Would you like to have a cup of tea?" Setelah "Would you like" dipakai "to" + kata kerja bentuk dasar, jadi jawabannya "to have".
soal:
Complete the sentence.
"Would you like ___ a cup of tea?"

pembahasan: Kalimat ajakan yang benar adalah "Let's go to the library after school." Setelah "Let's" dipakai kata kerja bentuk dasar, yaitu "go".
soal:
Complete the sentence.
"Let's ___ to the library after school."

pembahasan: Kalimat saran yang benar adalah "You'd better finish your homework now, or you will be late." Setelah "You'd better" dipakai kata kerja bentuk dasar, yaitu "finish". Kata "finishing" dan "finished" tidak cocok di sini.
soal:
Complete the sentence.
"You'd better ___ your homework now, or you will be late."

pembahasan: Kalimat saran yang benar adalah "If it rains, you should bring an umbrella." Kata "should" dipakai untuk memberi saran. Kata "must" menyatakan kewajiban yang keras dan kurang cocok untuk saran ini.
soal:
Complete the sentence.
"If it rains, you ___ bring an umbrella."

jawaban: Milo is a white cat with green eyes. He likes to sleep on my bed.
pembahasan: Jawaban yang baik harus menyebutkan: (1) Milo adalah kucing berbulu putih dan bermata hijau, (2) ia suka tidur di tempat tidur pemiliknya. Informasi itu ada di teks: "He has white fur and green eyes. He likes to sleep on my bed."
soal:
Read the text.
"I have a cat. His name is Milo. He has white fur and green eyes. He likes to sleep on my bed. He is very cute."

What does Milo look like, and what does he like to do? Answer in English.

jawaban: Kuta Beach is in Bali. The sand is white and the water is blue.
pembahasan: Jawaban yang baik harus menyebutkan: (1) Pantai Kuta ada di Bali, (2) pasirnya putih dan airnya biru. Informasi itu ada di teks: "Kuta Beach is in Bali. The sand is white and the water is blue."
soal:
Read the text.
"Kuta Beach is in Bali. The sand is white and the water is blue. Many tourists visit the beach every year. The beach is the most beautiful place in the world."

Where is Kuta Beach, and what does it look like? Answer in English.

pembahasan: Jawaban yang baik harus menyebutkan: (1) Borobudur adalah candi terkenal di Magelang, Jawa Tengah, (2) dibangun pada abad ke-9, (3) banyak wisatawan mengunjunginya setiap tahun. Ketiga poin itu ada di teks.
soal:
Read the text.
"Borobudur is a famous temple in Indonesia. It is in Magelang, Central Java. It was built in the ninth century. Many tourists visit Borobudur every year."

Why is Borobudur famous? Answer in English.

soal:
Read the text.

jawaban: Don't talk loudly in the library. Don't eat food in the library.
pembahasan: Jawaban yang baik harus berisi dua kalimat larangan (prohibition) yang sesuai dengan situasi perpustakaan, memakai "Don't" + kata kerja bentuk dasar, misalnya: "Don't talk loudly in the library." dan "Don't eat food in the library." Kalimat dengan "must" atau "should" bukan kalimat larangan.
soal:
Read the situation.
You are in the school library. Some students are reading books quietly. Write two prohibition sentences for this situation. Answer in English.

jawaban: Don't smoke in the hospital. Don't make a noise in the hospital.
pembahasan: Jawaban yang baik harus berisi dua kalimat larangan (prohibition) yang sesuai dengan situasi rumah sakit, memakai "Don't" + kata kerja bentuk dasar, misalnya: "Don't smoke in the hospital." dan "Don't make a noise in the hospital." Kalimat dengan "must" atau "should" bukan kalimat larangan.
soal:
Read the situation.
You are in a hospital. Many patients are resting in their rooms. Write two prohibition sentences for this situation. Answer in English.

jawaban: Rina: "Excuse me, Sir. May I go to the toilet?" Teacher: "Yes, you may." Rina: "Thank you, Sir."
pembahasan: Dialog yang benar harus tersusun: (1) permintaan izin yang sopan ("Excuse me, Sir. May I go to the toilet?"), (2) jawaban memberi izin ("Yes, you may."), (3) ucapan terima kasih ("Thank you, Sir."). Urutan ini masuk akal dalam percakapan.
soal:
Arrange the sentences into a short dialog about asking for permission.
1. "Thank you, Sir."
2. "Yes, you may."
3. "Excuse me, Sir. May I go to the toilet?"

Write the correct dialog in English.

jawaban: Budi: "Can I borrow your dictionary, please?" Sinta: "Of course. Here it is." Budi: "Thank you very much."
pembahasan: Dialog yang benar harus tersusun: (1) permintaan izin yang sopan ("Can I borrow your dictionary, please?"), (2) jawaban memberi izin ("Of course. Here it is."), (3) ucapan terima kasih ("Thank you very much."). Urutan ini masuk akal dalam percakapan.
soal:
Arrange the sentences into a short dialog about asking for permission.
1. "Of course. Here it is."
2. "Thank you very much."
3. "Can I borrow your dictionary, please?"

Write the correct dialog in English.

"ANNOUNCEMENT
